page.overview:
Who is Owen Anthony?

Owen Anthony was a Gryffindor student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. He once signed up for Quidditch training at 7pm on Thursday on a sign-up sheet that was posted on the Gryffindor common room.

Owen is a male given name of Welsh origin, possibly derived from Eugene, cognate to Gaelic Eòghan.
